capabilities_done: (1) 3D parenting (f693651): three_d::Affine3 (layer map position + R S (p - anchor), S = diag(sx, sy, 1); then/inverse/cofactor); Transform3d.parent = the ancestor chain (identity without a parent, bit-identical to before); world(), normal() (cofactor image, so a non-uniform parent scale shears the plane correctly), layer_point() through the chain inverse, so shading, shadows and the depth sort follow the chain. Mixing (Studio reading, UNVERIFIED): a 2D ancestor of a 3D layer acts at Z 0 turned about Z; a 2D child of a 3D parent keeps the parent's 2D part (X/Y position, Z rotation, X/Y scale, anchor). Parented cameras (camera_in: position and point of interest mapped; one-node turns by rotation_part of the chain) and parented lights. Refused typed: a camera or light as anyone's parent (composition_3d_parent), a singular chain (composition_3d_parent_degenerate), loops (Folio ContainmentCycle; adapter walk bounded, Cycle).

(2) masks and track mattes on 3D layers (06b5671; STU-CMP-010 steps 2 and 7): masks rasterised in LAYER space over the content rectangle (Plane3d.layer_mask, mask_paths coverage through the content origin) multiply the content alpha before shading, defocus and the projection, so they follow the plane in perspective and masked-out texels cast no shadow (Caster.mask); the track matte (Plane3d.track_matte) multiplies in SCREEN space after the projection, nested under every depth piece's rank matte (coverage = rank x matte); a 3D matte source is projected alone and unlit through the active camera; masks and a track matte combine on one 3D layer. Fix: matte sources (which never render) no longer count as run breaks or join shadow-diagnostic runs (scene_at already skipped them). Still refused (composition_3d_layer_option): corner pin, clipping, unlinked vector mask on a 3D layer.

(3) STU-CMP-050 auxiliary channels (9353b80): three_d::aux_channels -> AuxChannels with planes Z (camera depth, +inf where nothing is hit), N.X/N.Y/N.Z (camera-space unit normal facing the camera), objectId (1-based stack index; ids table to layer ids) and coverage, taken per pixel centre from the front-most plane whose content texel (nearest, after the layer mask) has alpha x opacity > 0; channel identifier AUX_CHANNEL_NAMES / channels() / channel(name); composition::three_d_aux_channels renders the plane contents through the context backend; CompositionTemporalSource::three_d_planes_at (planes, ids, camera across run breaks) and three_d_aux_channels. Export: three_d::exr::encode_exr_f32 (single-part scanline OpenEXR, uncompressed FLOAT channels sorted by name, required header attributes, offset table) and AuxChannels::to_exr. Consumers: depth_matte (slice with linear feather, +inf beyond any finite far), id_matte, depth_fog. Typed refusals: mismatched inputs (InvalidState), object id 0, > 2^28 pixel-plane tests (BudgetExceeded before allocation), EXR dims/channel set/name (empty, > 31 bytes, non-printable, repeated)/length/budget, matte and fog parameters (composition_3d_aux_parameter); Cryptomatte, depth-of-field-from-depth and imported-file channel extraction refused by name (composition_3d_aux_capability_unsupported).

(4) STU-CMP-055 / 055a immersive (slice 4): Folio StudioComposition.immersive = StudioImmersiveSettings, all nine STU-VID-018 fields (serde default, byte-identical when absent; validated: projection 0 flat / 1 equirectangular, stereo 0 mono / 1 over-under / 2 side-by-side, eye 0/1, views (0, 360] x (0, 180], ambisonics 0 none, hrir label) - Studio-authored members of declared gaps STU-CMP-106 / STU-VID-082. composite: three_d::immersive (capability list of the 20 named, equirect_direction, sphere_rotate with wrapped longitude and clamped latitude, ImmersiveScene), three_d::ray_hit (Cramer through the plane's world map, parents included), composition::render_equirect ('plane to sphere': per-pixel spherical ray cast of every plane, plane contents from the context backend incl. lights/shadows/layer masks, bilinear premultiplied sample, normal composite farthest first over the background), CompositionTemporalSource::immersive_scene_at. Typed refusals: 18 unbuilt capabilities (composition_immersive_capability_unsupported), unknown names (composition_immersive_capability_unknown), missing settings / projection other than equirectangular / stereo / partial sphere / zero or > 16384 side / non-finite rotation / shape mismatch (composition_immersive_parameters), visible 2D content layer / track matte / non-normal blend / camera depth of field (composition_immersive_layer), > 32 planes (composition_3d_run_limit).
